product.name: Wallbarn Universal Extra Adjustable Pedestal for Decking and Paving
product.description: Wallbarn's Universal  Extra adjustable pedestal range is suitable for both paving and decking. They are particularly ideal for porcelain tiles on flat roofs and podiums. Even flat roofs are built to a small fall to allow adequate drainage. The adjustable pedestals have a telescopic stem which allow you to make millimetre-precise manual adjustments in height in order to achieve a flat upper surface. Universal Extra pedestals are a freestanding system, so no fixings are made through the membrane underneath, ideal for warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systems. They also come with an integrated acoustic shim on the headpiece. The pedestals create a cavity between the sub-deck and the paving/decking surface which helps ventilate the structure and allows services such as pipes and cables to be hidden from view.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Universal Extra Adjustable Pedestal for Decking and PavingSuitable for paving and decking, including porcelain tiles on flat roofs and podiumsAdjustable telescopic stem for precise height adjustmentsUniversal Extra pedestals are freestanding, meaning no fixings through the membraneIdeal for warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systemsIntegrated acoustic shim on the headpieceCreates a cavity for ventilation and hiding pipes and cablesHeight markings every 10mm on stems for easy adjustmentEach pedestal includes an extension shankMaximum load is 11,493 N (1,171 kg)Wallbarn's Universal EXTRA pedestals give installers greater flexibility when working across surfaces with very large differences in deck level as the height range is far greater across just three products: 85mm-135mm, 125mm-215mm and 210mm-380mm.Often installers cannot be sure exactly where the fall will be on the roof or by how much. These pedestals have the heights marked out every 10mm on the side of stems, so users can see at a glance the exact height they are adjusting to without having to constantly re-measure. Each EXTRA pedestal comes complete with an extension shank which clicks into the baseplate. The threaded stem is then placed into the top of it. Paving applicationsPositioning lugs create uniform spacing between each slab, allowing rainwater to run between and under the slabs, so no standing water is left on the surfaceBeing a suspended system, the weight of the slab holds everything in placeHeight adjustments can be made whilst the slab is in place, saving time and labour10mm high lugs mean they are ideal for supporting thin tilesLugs can be snapped by hand for stretcher bond and irregular laying patternsLaying deckingAdjusting the height of the pedestals, rather than cutting furring's means installers can install decking onto structural decks much more quicklyPedestals are adjusted to accommodate the fall in the roof deckPlaced a maximum of 600mm apart, the joist bearers are simply slotted between the joist holdersA joist framework is constructed to create a sturdy, stable, weight-bearing surface to take the upper surfacingThe top decking is then fixed onto the joists using ordinary wood screws or hidden fixingsHeight adjustments can be made whilst the timber joist framework is in place, saving time and labourRaising the decking off the sub-deck allows water to drain freely under the decking so there is no standing water left on the surface, preventing ponding and associated slip hazards, and extending the lifespan of the timber.Joists are not standing directly on the waterproofing membrane, or insulation, preventing damage to it.

product.name: Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Pedestal For Decking and Paving
product.description: Available in a selection of height options, this Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Paving and Decking Support from Wallbarn is designed to form flat surfaces for paved or decked structures. While especially suited to use alongside porcelain tiles on podiums and flat roofs, these pedestals provide adjustments that are precise to the millimetre with the telescopic stem across various flat surfaces.The free-standing system requires no fixings, in turn sparing below membranes from hindrance and suiting warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systems. The pedestals create a gap between the paving or decking and the sub-deck for the purpose of ventilation, while effectively hiding unpleasant pipes and cables.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Pedestal For Decking and PavingVirgin fibre injection moulded polypropylene structureCompressive Strength between +20°C and -40°CCost-effective and sturdyEnd of Linear Behaviour: 6,700N = 683kgWeight Tolerance: Maximum Load 11,493 N = 1,171kg200mm base plate diameter and 120mm headpiece diameter55mm distance between lugs which are 10mm x 2mm (4mm upon request)-40°C to 75°CIntegrated acoustic shim on the headpieceLaying DeckingAdjusting the pedestal height instead of cutting furring’s quickens installation and accommodates falls in the roof deck. Joist bearers easily slot between joist holders when situated a maximum of 600mm apart. A joist framework is formed for a sturdy, stable, weight-bearing surface to take the upper surfacing and the top decking can then be fixed onto the joists with wood screws or discrete fixings. You can make height adjustments when the timber joist framework is in place to reduce both time and labour. Raising the decking off the sub-deck lets water drain beneath the decking to: avoid standing water on the surface, prolong timber lifespan, stop ponding, and limit resulting slip hazards. Joists are not standing directly on the waterproofing membrane, or insulation, to avoid damage.Standards & CertificationConforms to quality management systems standard UNI EN ISO 9001 2008Fire rating classed as 'EUROCLASSE E' according to EN 135011 2009.

product.name: Wallbarn TD Minipad Adjustable Support Pad
product.description: The TD Minipad Adjustable Support Pad by Wallbarn is an effective solution for your suspended timber decking system. Manufactured from high-quality virgin fibre injection-moulded polypropylene, these support pads are engineered to ensure excellent strength and durability, offering incredible weight tolerance of up to 683kg.Designed with precision and innovation in mind, the TD Minipad is ideal for areas with low height thresholds, where minor height adjustments are required for a flawless finish. It supports timber joists for top surface deck boards, making it perfect for balconies, terraces, and podium decks. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn TD Minipad Adjustable Support PadIdeal for suspended timber decking systemsMade from high-quality virgin fibre injection-moulded polypropyleneImpressive weight tolerance of up to 683kgPrecise millimetre-height adjustments with telescopic stemsDiiferent sizes availableSuitable for balconies, terraces, and podium decksFast and easy installation, saving time and labour150mm diameter headpieces and baseplates for stabilityEnhanced drainage, ventilation, and concealed space for servicesWhat sets the TD Minipad apart is its millimetre-precise height adjustment capabilities. The telescopic stems allow for easy and fast installation, enabling you to achieve the desired height with minimal effort. These adjustable support pads save you both time and labour during construction, as adjustments can be made while the timber joists are in place. The 150mm diameter headpieces and baseplates ensure stability and reliability.In addition to its functionality, the TD Minipad offers enhanced drainage with its suspended system, preventing standing water on the surface. product.name: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain Outlet
product.description: Available in different lengths and diameters, this perforated roof drain outlet from Wallbarn is made of flexible and strong TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer). It works to add a waterproof element to drainage holes on both balconies and roofs that are already equipped with bituminous waterproofing membranes. With resilience to weathering and UV rays, this outlet can withstand temperature changes up to 120°C and resist brittleness in lower temperatures.Where holes are made in concrete decks, this outlet is easily installed after a layer of waterproof membrane and then coated with a second layer on top of the flange - which has a perforated edge for the membrane to settle in for a secure and sturdy bond. The 240mm shank fits into an HDPE (High-density polyethylene) pipe snuggly and is slightly coned to ease the fit and provide additional stability. Water is prevented from travelling back up thanks to the two rings that emulate a drain tap, and the serrated area allows for a drain guard to join the system.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain OutletMade from TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer) for durability, resilience, and waterproofingInstalled alongside two layers of a waterproofing membranePerforated flange to help bondingConed shank with serrated area to ease installation and allow for drain guardsUV stable and able to withstand high (120°C) and low temperatures.Compatible with SBS (Styrene Butadiene Styrene) and APP (Atactic Polypropylene Membrane) membranes, such as built-up (felt), hot melt, mastic asphalt, and other liquid-applied membranes.Please note: Do not allow direct contact with concrete as this can allow water to find its way beneath the outlet and cause damage.Assure that a layer of membrane is fully bonded to the outlet flange and the first layer for completely watertight bonds.
product.variant_name: Roofdrain Outlet (TPE) Perforated 600mm High - 80mm Diameter

product.name: Wallbarn TPE Extension Shank
product.description:
Wallbarn extension shanks are designed to fix up with the drainage outlets to increase the reach into the parapet wall or drainage channel.
Often the ducts and channels will have to pass through a long run of concrete before reaching a suitable area to install the HDPE drainpipe, so an extension of a fully waterproof sealed connector will be required. These extension shanks are specially designed to fit in with the full range of Wallbarn circular outlets.
They are made from TPE but can still be used with EPDM and PVC outlets. They are manufactured to a slight cone shape, so the end of the circular outlet slots inside the top of the extension shank. The two membranes are bonded together using silicone adhesive.
Please note: Installers of PVC waterproofing systems should always inform waterproofing manufacturer before using these two materials together in order check the status of the warranty.

Often the ducts and channels will have to pass through a long run of concrete before reaching a suitable area to install the HDPE drainpipe, so an extension of a fully waterproof sealed connector will be required. These extension shanks are specially designed to fit in with the full range of Wallbarn circular outlets.
They are made from TPE but can still be used with EPDM and PVC outlets. They are manufactured to a slight cone shape, so the end of the circular outlet slots inside the top of the extension shank. The two membranes are bonded together using silicone adhesive.
Please note: Installers of PVC waterproofing systems should always inform waterproofing manufacturer before using these two materials together in order check the status of the warranty.

product.name: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable Pedestal
product.description: The specially designed Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA adjustable pedestals are ideal for decking and paving projects. The self-levelling headpieces have been developed to give extra scope and flexibility, so differences are accommodated within the surface beneath the pedestal. The BALANCE also helps alleviate blemishes and ridges in the sub-deck or changes in the thickness of your paving slabs which makes the upper surface uneven.Whereas BALANCE pedestals are available in heights from 25mm up to 395mm, BALANCE EXTRA pedestals give an extended height range from 100mm up to 395mm in just three different products.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable PedestalIdeal for decking and pavingEasier and faster than old fashioned methodsSpecially designed to give extra scope and flexibilityHeight: 222mm - 392mm, 137mm - 227mm, 97mm - 147mmType: AdjustableThis suspended system uses the weight of the slab or decking to hold everything into place. Rainwater runs between and underneath, so there is no standing water left on the surface of your floor. This dramatically reduces the risk of slipping and causing serious injury.You can hide unsightly objects such as cables, water pipes and drainage outlets underneath the paving slabs as well, improving the aesthetics of your floor.Decking ApplicationsWhen used with timber decking systems, the lugs(fins) are set out towards the edges of the headpiece to give a 55mm gap between each one. This allows a timber joist to fit between the lugs (fins), and then decking boards are can be fixed to the joist frame. Installers are able to create decking surfaces onto structural decks much faster by adjusting the height of pedestals rather than cutting furrings.Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece design has four positioning lugs (fins) laid out in a crucifix formation set towards the edges of the headpiece. The design means that it robust, stable and durable. The headpiece has separate parts that allow up to 5% or 2.86 degrees of slope correction in all directions. This allows smooth movement and positioning of the paving slab. Slips and sharp tilting are avoided owing to the superior design and solid manufacture. The lugs (fins) separate paving slabs and tiles on the headpiece to allow sufficient drainage between slabs, which create a uniform paving line, so the slabs are laid entirely straight. A rubber anti-shock pad can slot onto the headpiece to give a better grip to the slab and help insulate against vibration and noise travelling through to the deck beneath.Please note: Shims, slope correctors, cross spacers and other accessories can also be used with the BALANCE Pedestals.

product.name: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking Pedestal
product.description: Wallbarn's Mega Balance Self-Levelling Pedestals are an easy-to-install four-in-one solution that you can use in various applications, thanks to its ingenious headpiece design that supports not only decking joists and bearers but also paving slabs and tiles.With a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mm, this heavy-duty suspended system means the weight of the paving slabs or tiles ballasts themselves securely into position. Each pedestal is made from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillers, which will provide long-term durability and performance. They have even been laboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking PedestalAn easy-to-install pedestal that supports both decking boards and paving slabs/tilesA self-levelling and fixed head pedestal all in oneHas a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mmSelf-levelling headpiece moves up to 5% or 2.86° in all directionsYou can adjust your pedestals slightly even after a project has been completed, saving on labour and improving health and safetyThe ‘grey nut’ can be pressed into the centre of the headpiece to lock the self-levelling mechanism should installers require fixed headsThe headpiece comes with an integrated rubber anti-shock pad, which clicks into place to give a better grip and improves vibration and noise insulationMade from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillersLaboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures1 black nut for every four units purchased.While the headpiece is self-levelling as standard, by using the 'grey nut', the head can be locked rigid within the same unit. If you need to adjust the height of your pedestals, you can do this using the 'yellow' and 'silver' key tools, even on a completed paving project, without having to lift and remove any of the slabs.For Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece incorporates 4 x 4mm wide positioning lugs (fins) integrated with the headpiece, helping to create a uniform paving line for your slabs and tiles. Not only does it aid the overall aesthetic of your paving, but with the headpiece’s lugs separating your tiles, this allows for improved drainage. To install, simply lay the paving slab or tile onto one segment of the headpiece so four corners of your paving slabs or tiles rest on each headpiece. This will ensure four pedestals support each corner of a slab or tile, providing stable and secure support. For Decking ApplicationsThe four positioning lugs on the self-levelling headpiece are set 55mm apart so a 50mm wide joist/bearer can be loose-laid between them easily. It is loose-laid rather than mechanically fixed in case of expansion or movement, which can cause differences between the structure beneath and the decking over time. The lugs are high enough to house the joists securely, giving you flexibility in your decking project. When laying your decking, the joists/bearers should be cross-fitted together to form a secure framework. The upper surface decking boards can then be mechanically fixed to the joist frame according to the specification and assembly instructions of the deck board supplier. Standards & CertificationFire Classification: EUROCLASS E according to EN 13501-1-2009Please note: You will only receive 1 black nut for every four units purchased. Installers may or may not wish to click the grey nut into the headpiece to lock the head, depending on the characteristics of the decking project.There are cut lines on the underside of the baseplates should installers need to pave directly up to walls or parapets - do not cut bases beyond these cut lines.Special CLASS B1 (EN 13501-1-2009) rated pedestals can be manufactured upon request.

product.description: Wallbarn's Mega Balance Self-Levelling Pedestals are an easy-to-install four-in-one solution that you can use in various applications, thanks to its ingenious headpiece design that supports not only decking joists and bearers but also paving slabs and tiles.With a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mm, this heavy-duty suspended system means the weight of the paving slabs or tiles ballasts themselves securely into position. Each pedestal is made from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillers, which will provide long-term durability and performance. They have even been laboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking PedestalAn easy-to-install pedestal that supports both decking boards and paving slabs/tilesA self-levelling and fixed head pedestal all in oneHas a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mmSelf-levelling headpiece moves up to 5% or 2.86° in all directionsYou can adjust your pedestals slightly even after a project has been completed, saving on labour and improving health and safetyThe ‘grey nut’ can be pressed into the centre of the headpiece to lock the self-levelling mechanism should installers require fixed headsThe headpiece comes with an integrated rubber anti-shock pad, which clicks into place to give a better grip and improves vibration and noise insulationMade from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillersLaboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures1 black nut for every four units purchased.While the headpiece is self-levelling as standard, by using the 'grey nut', the head can be locked rigid within the same unit. If you need to adjust the height of your pedestals, you can do this using the 'yellow' and 'silver' key tools, even on a completed paving project, without having to lift and remove any of the slabs.For Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece incorporates 4 x 4mm wide positioning lugs (fins) integrated with the headpiece, helping to create a uniform paving line for your slabs and tiles. Not only does it aid the overall aesthetic of your paving, but with the headpiece’s lugs separating your tiles, this allows for improved drainage. To install, simply lay the paving slab or tile onto one segment of the headpiece so four corners of your paving slabs or tiles rest on each headpiece. This will ensure four pedestals support each corner of a slab or tile, providing stable and secure support. For Decking ApplicationsThe four positioning lugs on the self-levelling headpiece are set 55mm apart so a 50mm wide joist/bearer can be loose-laid between them easily. It is loose-laid rather than mechanically fixed in case of expansion or movement, which can cause differences between the structure beneath and the decking over time. The lugs are high enough to house the joists securely, giving you flexibility in your decking project. When laying your decking, the joists/bearers should be cross-fitted together to form a secure framework. The upper surface decking boards can then be mechanically fixed to the joist frame according to the specification and assembly instructions of the deck board supplier. Standards & CertificationFire Classification: EUROCLASS E according to EN 13501-1-2009Please note: You will only receive 1 black nut for every four units purchased. Additional black Nuts can be purchased.In decking applications, there is no need to cut furrings as the pedestals are adjusted in height to create a flat frame level.The headpiece is self-levelling as standard. Installers may or may not wish to click the grey nut into the headpiece to lock the head, depending on the characteristics of the decking project.There are cut lines on the underside of the baseplates should installers need to pave directly up to walls or parapets - do not cut bases beyond these cut lines.Special CLASS B1 (EN 13501-1-2009) rated pedestals can be manufactured upon request.

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Naylor's land drain pipe filter sock geotextile is a great addition to pipe systems. Particularly in sandy and silty soil conditions.A special knit fabric, this sock allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe, then subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with water. The fabric prevents larger soil particles from passing through the fabric, causing a bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. An example of this is granular backfill materials.  The bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials and immediately surrounds the perforated drainage pipe.Features & Benefits: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock GeotextileSuitable for sandy and silty soil conditionsKnit fabricPrevents large soil particles from passing throughAllows fine soil particles to pass through

product.name: Naylor Pre-Loaded Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description:
The specially knit fabric allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe that are subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with the water. The remaining larger soil particles that are blocked from passing through the fabric, bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. Like granular backfill materials, the bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials immediately surrounding the perforated drainage pipe. It is particularly suited for use in sandy and silty soil conditions.

Prevents Clogging - Keeps water flowing
Screens out sand & sediment
No need For special backfill
Millions of meters in use worldwide

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Designed to complement Naylor Land Drain Pipes, this 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile is made from a specially knit fabric, which offers a unique solution by allowing ultra-fine soil particles to effortlessly flow through, joining the perforated pipe. As water flows, these fine particles are efficiently carried away, ensuring optimal drainage performance. What's more, this Filter Sock Geotextile also plays a crucial role in retaining larger soil particles. These particles, unable to pass through the fabric, create a bridging effect on its outer surface. This not only provides additional structural support but also enhances the permeability of the surrounding native backfill materials, mimicking the benefits of granular backfill. This geotextile is especially well-suited for sand and silty soil conditions. product.name: Marsh Whisspurr W-AVR Acoustic Vibration Reduction Unit
product.description:
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reaction (AVR) unit has been designed to limit noise levels and vibrations from diaphragm compressors used in the water and wastewater treatment sectors.
Suitable for all types of compressor including; Bibus Secoh, Nitto and Charles Austen, the Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit is easily fitted inline between the compressor and air diffuser. If space permits, the Marsh Whisspurr unit should be fitted as close as possible to the compressor – preferably, inside the sewage treatment plant.
Please note, the Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit is chemically sealed and bolted shut, which creates a pressure vacuum when in operation. Any tampering, breaking of the seal, or removal of any bolts will invalidate the warranty and will prevent the unit from working effectively. This unit is also not suitable for side channel blowers.
What are the benefits of the Marsh Whisppurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit?
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit’s innovative design ensures that any noise pollution emanating from the compressor unit is dramatically reduced without hindering the overall performance of the treatment system. Rural areas, where continuous noise is a nuisance, particularly benefits from AVR unit’s noise and vibration reduction qualities.
Available in four standard sizes, the corrosion free Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit does not require any electrics and can be easily installed into existing wastewater and water treatment systems.
Features and Benefits

Innovative UK design (patent pending).
Significantly reduces compressor volume and vibration without reducing in air pressure from the compressor.
No increase in back pressure to the compressor.
The unit contains no moving parts and requires no electrics.
Can be easily retrofitted to existing compressors.
Hose tail is 20mm standard.
Ideal for rural areas where noise pollution is a nuisance.
Available in four standard sizes.
Manufactured from resin and glass polymer, making the unit corrosion free and invulnerable to warm/humid conditions.
Unit is dark green as standard.

Specification
Overall unit width: 142mm
Overall unit height (excluding hose tail):200mm240mm350mm450mm
Material (unit): Resin and Glass Polymer
Material (hose tail connections): Brass with Stainless Steel nuts and bolts.
Colour: Dark Green

The Marsh cesspool cesspit tank is a covered, watertight unit for storing raw household sewage. It has no outlet and relies on road transport for the removal of raw sewage. No biological treatment is involved.

product.name: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description: The Ensign domestic sewage treatment plant comes with lifting eyes to make unloading and installation faster and safer. We designed the Ensign plant to self-level on the base and with our unique pipe connections ensure the installation is undertaken efficiently and correctly. The six person Ensign Sewage plant is extremely strong and is only 1.95m in depth with an inlet invert of 500mm, this design reduces both the time and cost of installation, in normal ground conditions the unit only requires a pea-shingle surround. For guidance ideally the Ensign plant should be 7m from a dwelling or10m from a stream.Package Sewage Treatment Plants (or PSTP's) are often a suitable option where groundwater in the surrounding environment is vulnerable, drainage field percolation values are restrictive, or direct discharge to watercourse or surface water sewer is the preferred discharge method. Marsh Industries Ensign range of sewage treatment plants treat final effluent to British and European Standards to allow it to be discharged back into the watercourse whilst reaching national consent standards. Our tanks can be manufactured with either a gravity or pumped outlet to meet your site requirements. At Marsh Industries we only use 100% virgin resin (no chalk fillers) in all our products. Lead times for Domestic Sewage Treatment Plants are normally only 5-7 working days. Comes with external compressor as standard.Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantNo moving partsLow running and maintenance costsEasy installation with keying-in lip and lifting eyesTested and certified to BSEN12566-350 year design life25 year structural guaranteeThe Ensign plant has been tested to EN12566:3-2005Highest testing standard for European testingThe Ensign can discharge direct to a ditch, watercourse or percolation bedSuitable for One 4 bed residence & Two 3 Bed Residences - 16 People or 25 people working.In addition to anaerobic digestion taking place in the primary settlement chamber the Ensign: Ultra unit allows the clarified water to pass into a second 'aeration' chamber where it is treated to remove the dissolved constituents. Here aerobic bacteria supported by diffused air and mobile media, ensures full treatment is achieved before the treated effluent and 'sloughed off' bacteria flows to a final settlement chamber. The final effluent is then discharged to the drainage field or watercourse via polylok filter.Please note: External Cabinet can be supplied free of charge, please state when ordering.

product.variant_name: Marsh Polylok 60 Person Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant - Pumped

product.name: Marsh Polylok Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The plant has low visual impact with unobtrusive lids. Easy access integral separate de-sludge pipe and almost silent running & odour free. Its is manufactured in the united kingdom & is backed with a 25 year structural guarantee. Invert risers and pumped outlets can be supplied for deeper drain connections. Designed with integral recycling system that makes it ideal for intermittent use.
Features

Endogeneous respiration, reducing the sludge and increasing the amount of dissolved oxygen in the primary chamber.
For Increased health and safety we fit our large plants with stabalising feet to protect the civil engineering installation team from being injured because of the movement and roll of the sewage treatment plant.
We fit kiddie-guards into our turrets to prevent either adults, children or animals falling into the plant during maintenance, this is an added assurance to our bolt down covers.
Carbon Vents will be fitted into our manhole covers reducing the need for external venting.
After the process is completed we fit a Polylok Tertiary Filter that reduces further the final suspended solids by 40% and further improves the final BOD.

Warranty & guarantee

The minimum design life of the tank structure is twenty five years. (internally & externally)
The compressor blower is covered by a two year guarantee.
The diffuser is covered by a five year guarantee.
Engineered using high performance materials.
All metal components stainless steel.

product.name: Marsh:Standard Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants are a cost-effective way of treating sewage and wastewater in an off-mains area. For large residential, commercial and industrial sites, including leisure sites, Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants will provide biological processing for effluent until it’s of a quality well within the British Water effluent standard.
This sewage treatment plant will provide effluent treatment for up to 85 people. Manufactured in the UK, the tank is made from GRP virgin unfilled resin to provide a durable and structurally secure tank that has consistent wall thickness and no fillers in the material. Built this way in part as a safety feature, Marsh:Standard plants also have turret guards and failure alarms for extra peace of mind.
A low energy compressor and high specification bacteria keep the Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plant running smoothly as the bacteria along with membrane diffusers ensure the circulation of effluent so that it’s all treated. The low energy compressor minimises running costs whilst the system needs minimal maintenance as the system itself has no moving parts.
Approved to BS12566, the heavy duty shell provides a long life for Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants. Alarms and 600mm lockable manhole covers are as standard.

product.name: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant is an effective solution for sewage treatment, designed to accommodate areas where a natural gravity flow is not feasible. By opting for a pumped treatment plant, the system will efficiently direct effluent to higher levels, ensuring an economical and environmentally friendly operation.
When installed correctly, the Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant operates virtually odour-free and near-silently, also offering a discreet design that will not create eyesores in your garden or outdoor spaces. It is recommended Ensign plants are positioned at a minimum distance of seven metres from a dwelling or ten metres from a stream.
Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantAn effective and environmentally friendly pumped solution for sewage treatment in areas without gravity flowEfficiently directs effluent to higher levels using a pumpDiscrete design, virtually odour-free and operates near-silentlyFeatures lifting eyes for easy unloading and self-levelling on the base for easy installationUnique pipe connections for efficient and cost-effective installationTreats effluent to British and European Standards25-year structural guarantee
Featuring lifting eyes, this treatment plant facilitates quick and safe unloading, while its self-levelling capability on the base ensures ease of installation. The unique and innovative pipe connections enable efficient and cost-effective installation, catering to various property sizes.
The Ensign range of sewage treatment plants excels in treating final effluent to both British and European Standards, meeting national consent standards for discharge into watercourses. Manufactured with 100% virgin resin, excluding chalk fillers, this plant prioritises sustainability. It has undergone rigorous testing, adhering to the highest European testing standard, EN12566:3-2005, enabling direct discharge to ditches, watercourses, or percolation beds.
Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 12566 3-2005
Please note: External Cabinet as standard. Fitted with an internal pumped outlet and will do a max head of 3m and 50m pumped distance. Outlet is 32mm MDPE.

product.name: Marsh Non-Return Valve for Underground Sewage System
product.description:
These Marsh non-return valves are for use with the Marsh Underground Sewage Treatment Systems.
They fit either an 110mm pipe or an 160mm pipe.
Non-return valves allow for a flow in only one direction and is fitted to ensure that the flows go through a pipe in the right direction, where pressure conditions may otherwise cause reversed flow.

product.name: JFC Twinwall Drain Pipe for Surface Water Drainage - 6000mm
product.description: Available in a range of diameters and with or without perforations to suit your installation needs, this JFC CorriPipe™ offers the perfect solution for effective surface drainage. Pipe is easily cut to size requirements on site

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with Ears
product.description:
This round downpipe with ears is made in conjunction with the cast aluminium Alumasc Heritage rainwater system and is a perfect feature for traditionally designed buildings in both refurbishment and new build applications and can be used as a direct alternative for cast-iron downpipes.  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves installations.
Available in 1, 2 or 3 metre lengths and a range of diameters to fit your needs, this circular downpipe is made from robust and corrosion-resistant aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas. Coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings, this downpipe is offered in a variety of colours with the option of a textured black surface to resemble cast iron. This downpipe provides the essential assistance for your gutter system by channelling rainwater from your roof to a drain at ground level.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with EarsManufactured in accordance with BS 8530 (previously BS 2997)  Made from extruded aluminium  Made in the UK by Alumasc for the cast aluminium Heritage rainwater system  Ideal for providing traditional architectural features for new build and refurbishment applications  A lightweight alternative for cast iron downpipes   Available in a variety of colours including textured black with BBA approved, factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Durable and non-corrosive aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas)  Easy to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Available in a range of lengths and diameters  Made from environmentally friendly, recyclable aluminium  Compatible with modern fast track building contractsThis extruded aluminium downpipe is easy to fix with pipe jointing for up to 100mm diameters by separate sockets to give maximum flexibility and welded on sockets for the 150mm downpipe. With a straightforward fixing to the wall by eared sockets, this downpipe needs minimal maintenance once installed. Manufactured in the UK to British standards and made from 100% recyclable aluminium.

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.
Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Performance

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe
product.description:
This aluminium rounded downpipe by Alumasc is ideal for providing water with an unobstructed and direct path down to the drainage system. Attaching this downpipe to the rest of the Heritage range of guttering is achieved with cast sockets.
As a product from the Heritage collection by Alumasc, this downpipe holds many benefits and advantages – compatible with many eave installations on builds with a more traditional aesthetic, even newer ones, Heritage pipes are unlikely to corrode due to the durable aluminium structures and therefore make any required maintenance simple and fast. The range includes a versatile as-sortment of fitting methods, including wall fixings, brackets, and pipe clips.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular DownpipeColour assortment  UK made  Non-heavy but durable  Recyclable extruded aluminium  Created in line with BBA (British Board of Agrément) and quality British standards (BS 8530)  Multiple sizes and lengths to choose from. Like its fellow Heritage guttering items, this circular downpipe is an aluminium extrusion that can have a BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder finish that bears a resemblance to cast iron. In turn, this system is an ideal substitute for real cast iron fittings.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Stop End
product.description:
Part of Alumasc's durable and long-lasting 'Heritage' range, these Victorian ogee stop ends combine period style with modern materials. Designed specifically as a direct replacement for older cast iron fittings, these stop ends boast an impressive service life of up to forty years in rural or suburban areas. Combining longevity and versatility, the Heritage system is ready for your next retrofit or ground-up guttering project with an extensive range of fixture options and minimal maintenance.
This gutter system is lightweight, durable, and highly resistant to corrosion, having earned British Standards (BS) and British Board of Agrément (BBA) approval. In addition, these sections come in a range of imperial measurements as well as a variety of popular profiles, with the system serving as an excellent substitute for that characteristic cast-iron texture.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Stop EndHard-wearing coated aluminium means these gutters can last up to forty years in suburban and rural areasMeets with British Standards and British Board of Agrément specificationsDesigned specifically for replacing older cast-iron fixturesSuitable for both flush and projecting eave applications

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe 112.5dg Branch 100mm - Black

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe
product.description:
This aluminium rounded downpipe by Alumasc is ideal for providing water with an unobstructed and direct path down to the drainage system. Attaching this downpipe to the rest of the Heritage range of guttering is achieved with cast sockets.
As a product from the Heritage collection by Alumasc, this downpipe holds many benefits and advantages – compatible with many eave installations on builds with a more traditional aesthetic, even newer ones, Heritage pipes are unlikely to corrode due to the durable aluminium structures and therefore make any required maintenance simple and fast. The range includes a versatile as-sortment of fitting methods, including wall fixings, brackets, and pipe clips.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular DownpipeColour assortment  UK made  Non-heavy but durable  Recyclable extruded aluminium  Created in line with BBA (British Board of Agrément) and quality British standards (BS 8530)  Multiple sizes and lengths to choose from. Like its fellow Heritage guttering items, this circular downpipe is an aluminium extrusion that can have a BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder finish that bears a resemblance to cast iron. In turn, this system is an ideal substitute for real cast iron fittings.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Running Outlet
product.description:
A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.
Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Performance

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Stop End
product.description:
Part of Alumasc's durable and long-lasting 'Heritage' range, these Victorian ogee stop ends combine period style with modern materials. Designed specifically as a direct replacement for older cast iron fittings, these stop ends boast an impressive service life of up to forty years in rural or suburban areas. Combining longevity and versatility, the Heritage system is ready for your next retrofit or ground-up guttering project with an extensive range of fixture options and minimal maintenance.
This gutter system is lightweight, durable, and highly resistant to corrosion, having earned British Standards (BS) and British Board of Agrément (BBA) approval. product.description:
This aluminium rounded downpipe by Alumasc is ideal for providing water with an unobstructed and direct path down to the drainage system. Attaching this downpipe to the rest of the Heritage range of guttering is achieved with cast sockets.
As a product from the Heritage collection by Alumasc, this downpipe holds many benefits and advantages – compatible with many eave installations on builds with a more traditional aesthetic, even newer ones, Heritage pipes are unlikely to corrode due to the durable aluminium structures and therefore make any required maintenance simple and fast. Like its fellow Heritage guttering items, this circular downpipe is an aluminium extrusion that can have a BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder finish that bears a resemblance to cast iron. In turn, this system is an ideal substitute for real cast iron fittings.

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe 112.5dg Branch 75mm - Black

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe Shoe with Ears 63mm - Black

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Heritage Round Downpipe Ornamental Hopper Head 75mm - Textured Black

product.name: Alumasc Old Style Rafter Bracket 40 Degrees Half Round Top Fix
product.description:
As part of the cast aluminium Heritage gutter system, this old-style rafter bracket is available in a range of two different sizes to fit your gutter needs, giving support as a top fix to your Half Round gutters. This 40° top fix is ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications.
Durable and non-corrosive, this bracket is made from pressure diecast aluminium and has a long life expectancy of up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas) and 40 years (rural/suburban areas) with minimal upkeep requirements once installed. As a perfect alternative to resemble cast iron, this bracket is suited to both new build and refurbishment applications for traditionally designed buildings with a BBA accredited process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings.  Light and easy to handle and install, this bracket is provided with the appropriate fixing holes with a straightforward fix to the wall.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Old Style Rafter Bracket 40 Degrees Half Round Top FixManufactured in accordance to British standards with BS 8530 (formerly BS2997)  UK manufactured by Alumasc from LM6 grade aluminium alloy  Environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  BBA certified factory coated polyester powder  Direct replacement of cast iron with textured black appearance  Suited to modern fast track building contracts  Pressure diecast and provided with fixing holes  Light in weight and easy to fix  Minimum maintenance required  Perfect fit for traditionally designed buildings for architectural features in new build and refurb applications

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Beaded Deep Run Gutter
product.description:
These Alumasc 'Heritage' beaded deep-run gutters are the starting point for a reliable and robust range of guttering sections and fittings. An ideal pairing for traditional buildings that need every ounce of character preserved, these gutter sections are perfect for replacing older, heavier cast-iron fixtures or lending style to all sorts of contemporary builds. 
The 'Heritage' range uses durable coated aluminium to produce longevity, quality, and versatility for the best results in both flush and projecting eave applications. With British Standards (BS) and British Board of Agrément (BBA) approval, this gutter system can last up to forty years in rural and suburban areas. product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 106mm Prostyle Union Bracket
product.description: From Brett Martin's Prostyle range, this union bracket is ideal for conservatories, bungalows and can handle large home applications because of its unique design. The design also offers excellent aesthetics as it is visually compact and comes in a variety of colours to ensure you have the right one for your property. Installing the bracket is quick and easy. Only 106mm across, the gutter is small enough to be ideally suited to conservatories or bungalows, whilst having sufficient capacity to handle larger houses due to its unique design.
Moulded seals and fixing wings are on all relevant fittings with the option of a hidden, top hung, fascia bracket also available. Connects to 68mm Roundstyle, 65mm Squarestyle and 68mm Cast Iron Style downpipe and available in White, Black, Brown and Cast Iron Style finish.
Like all Brett Martin rainwater products the use of UV stabilised plastic is standard so that systems retain their high quality appearance thus giving excellent durability.
Features

High profile front conceals roof edge and helps prevent overspill.
Moulded seals provide high level of fitting integrity.
Outlets, unions and angles feature external fixing wings for easy access during installation which saves time.
Choice of hidden or exposed fascia brackets.
None of the fittings have open fixing holes in the wet part of the system.
Integral flexible clips on fittings ease installation.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 106mm Prostyle Internal Angle
product.description:
Straight forward installation and excellent aesthetics are provided by this visually compact yet highly efficient profiled gutter system. Only 106mm across, the gutter is small enough to be ideally suited to conservatories or bungalows, whilst having sufficient capacity to handle larger houses due to its unique design.
Moulded seals and fixing wings are on all relevant fittings with the option of a hidden, top hung, fascia bracket also available. Connects to 68mm Roundstyle, 65mm Squarestyle and 68mm Cast Iron Style downpipe and available in White, Black, Brown and Cast Iron Style finish.
Like all Brett Martin rainwater products the use of UV stabilised plastic is standard so that systems retain their high quality appearance thus giving excellent durability.
Features

High profile front conceals roof edge and helps prevent overspill.
Moulded seals provide high level of fitting integrity.
Outlets, unions and angles feature external fixing wings for easy access during installation which saves time.
Choice of hidden or exposed fascia brackets.
None of the fittings have open fixing holes in the wet part of the system.
Integral flexible clips on fittings ease installation.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 114mm Squarestyle Gutter Fascia Bracket
product.description:
The shape of the 114mm squarestyle rainwater system provides a very clean and simple look, ideal in structures with contemporary styling. The clean lines of the gutter and downpipe systems give a flow capacity up to 20% higher than half round systems which means not only does Squarestyle look good it performs well.
Squarestyle like Roundstyle, Deepstyle and Prostyle features integral fixing clips that allow quick and easy snap together assembly on the gutter length. Careful design ensures these are robust enough to provide years of trouble free service yet are flexible enough to allow simple installation. The outlets and unions feature external fixing wings, making them power tool friendly for simple installation.

product.description:
